decisions.reason: The compact dumper builds directly on the firm's long-standing construction machinery expertise and still has its own page, so the firm can interpret its results and improve it in-house.
The articulated dumper is a core competence of this type of firm and remains prominently presented, indicating continued commitment based on related knowledge.

The mine rescue vehicle draws on the firm's underground mining vehicle know-how, but its demotion from its own page to a mention suggests weaker traction, so the drop risk is elevated without being decisive.
The compact telescopic loader fits the firm's compact machinery knowledge base and is still presented on its own page.
The material lift is a long-established, popular rental product with a recent large order, so it rests on deep existing knowledge and proven demand.
The compact mining loader builds on the firm's underground expertise and shows quantified field results (1,000 hours in 7 months) that the firm can learn from and use to improve it.
